info.title: NEP Programme API
info.description: API documentation for authentication and programme entry management

get.description: Only accessible to nep_admin. Supports filtering by status and search.

post.description: Creates a new organisation. Optionally accepts a logo file (jpg, png, or webp, max 2MB) in the same request. Only accessible to nep_admin.

logo.description: Optional logo image (jpg, png, webp, max 10MB)

post.summary: Upload or replace an organisation's logo
post.description: Accepts an image file (jpg, png, or webp, max 10MB). Replaces any existing logo. Only accessible to nep_admin.

422.description: Validation failed — invalid file type or size

get.description: Only accessible to nep_admin.

patch.description: Soft-deactivates an organisation (sets status to inactive and records the timestamp). Does not delete data — preserves history for existing programme entries and users. Only accessible to nep_admin.
Sets status back to active and clears the last_inactive_at timestamp. Only accessible to nep_admin.

422.description: Validation failed, or modifying a system role identity (system roles may only have their permissions updated)

get.description: Only accessible to nep_admin. Supports filtering by role and status.

post.description: Creates an NEP staff or member organisation account. If no password is supplied, a temporary password is generated and returned once in the response.

permissions.description: Permission IDs to assign directly to this user. Omit to keep role-derived permissions.

get.description: Returns a user with organisation, roles and role permissions.

patch.description: Update user account fields. Leave password blank to keep the current password.

password.description: Leave blank to keep current password

permissions.description: Permission IDs. An empty array clears all individually assigned permissions (falls back to role defaults).

post.summary: Invite a new user via email
post.description: Creates a new user account with a default password and sends an invitation email. Prevents duplicate invitations for existing email addresses.

message.example: User created successfully. Invitation email has been sent.

422.description: Validation error or email already exists

post.description: Sets status to inactive and revokes all API tokens. An admin cannot deactivate their own account.

post.summary: Reactivate a previously deactivated user account
post.description: Sets the account status back to active.
Generates a new temporary password server-side and revokes all existing tokens. The temporary password is returned once in the response for the admin to relay securely.

message.example: Credentials reset. Share the temporary password with the user securely.

post.summary: Query map entries by overlap with an extracted programme profile
post.description: Returns ProgrammeEntry records that overlap with the provided programme profile on at least one of: activity, geography, audience. Respects analysis_scope (full map / geographic subset / thematic subset).

get.description: Returns a paginated list of Adviser document submission records. Only NEP Coordinators and Admins can retrieve submission records. Supports filtering by analysis scope and status.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of records per page (default: 25, max: 100)

403.description: Forbidden - Only NEP Coordinators and Admins can retrieve submission records

post.summary: Submit a document for Adviser analysis
post.description: Allows NEP Coordinators and Admins to submit a document for analysis. The submitting party is captured as free text (not linked to the member database). Analysis scope defaults to 'full map' when not specified.

submitting_party.description: Name of the submitting party (free text, not linked to member database)

document_name.description: Name or title of the document being submitted

analysis_scope.description: Scope of analysis: 'full map', 'geographic subset', or 'thematic subset'

analysis_scope_detail.description: Additional details about the analysis scope (required for geographic or thematic subsets)
analysis_scope_detail.example: Focus on Phnom Penh and Siem Reap provinces

status.description: Status of the submission (e.g. Submitted for review, Adviser Delivered). Defaults to 'Submitted for review' if not provided.

403.description: Forbidden - Only NEP Coordinators and Admins can submit documents

get.description: Returns a single adviser submission with its staff assignment and recommendations.

patch.description: Update the coordinator assignment and/or sections for an adviser submission.

assign_to_staff_user_id.description: Staff user ID to assign the submission to

get.summary: Get the advisory note for a programme entry
get.description: Returns the advisory note (with all sections and recommendations) linked to a specific programme entry. Used by the 'Analyse in the Adviser' button on the programme entry view.

404.description: No advisory note found for this programme entry

patch.summary: Mark an adviser submission as delivered
patch.description: Sets the submission status to 'advice_delivered' and records the delivery timestamp.

get.summary: Download the uploaded advisory note PDF file
get.description: Streams the uploaded final advisory note PDF file. Only accessible by NEP Admin and NEP Coordinator.

404.description: No file uploaded for this advisory note

post.description: Authenticate a user with email and password and return a Sanctum access token.

get.description: Retrieve the role and organisation context of the currently authenticated user.

post.description: Invalidate the current Sanctum token session.

patch.description: Change the authenticated user's password. Requires current password verification.

get.description: Returns aggregate counts for the dashboard. Accessible to NEP Admins and Coordinators. For admins, coordinator_advisory_notes is null.

403.description: Forbidden — not a nep_admin or nep_coordinator

put.summary: Save keywords for a programme entry
put.description: Accepts an array of keyword strings. Replaces all existing keywords for the entry.

404.description: Programme entry not found, or caller not authorized

put.summary: Save Section 4 government agreements for a programme entry
put.description: Accepts an array of agreement records. Existing rows (identified by id) are updated, new rows (no id) are created, and any existing rows not present in the array are deleted. Each enum field is validated against its allowed values.

institution_name.example: Kampong Cham Provincial Office of Education

404.description: Programme entry not found, or caller not authorized

get.description: Returns a list of all provinces for populating frontend dropdowns.
Returns districts belonging to the specified province.

200.description: List of districts for the province

get.description: Returns communes belonging to the specified district.

200.description: List of communes for the district

get.description: Returns villages belonging to the specified commune.

200.description: List of villages for the commune

get.description: Returns each province with the count of distinct programme entries linked to it. Ordered by count descending.

200.description: List of provinces with programme counts

get.summary: Query programme entries for map display
get.description: Returns entries matching the given filters. All filters combine with AND. Respects BE-010/BE-025 visibility rules: nep_admin and nep_coordinator see all entries, member_org sees only their own organisation's entries.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number per page, or omit for cached full result

get.summary: Export filtered programme entries as CSV
get.description: Returns a CSV file containing all key fields for entries matching the given filters. Uses the same filters and permissions as the query endpoint.

get.summary: Export filtered programme entries as PDF summary report
get.description: Returns a PDF file containing a readable summary report of entries matching the given filters. Large result sets are processed in chunks to prevent timeouts.

get.summary: Get province-level GeoJSON with entry counts for map visualization
get.description: Returns a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of provinces, each containing the count of matching programme entries. Only accessible by nep_admin and nep_coordinator.

get.summary: Get the current user's organisation profile

patch.summary: Update the current user's organisation profile

post.description: Sends a password reset link to the given email if an account with that email exists. Always returns 200 regardless of whether the email exists, to avoid leaking which emails are registered.

200.description: Reset link sent if the account exists

message.example: If an account exists for that email, a reset link has been sent.

post.summary: Reset password using a token from the reset link
post.description: Validates the reset token and sets a new password. Revokes all existing API tokens for the account once the password is reset.

message.example: Password reset successfully. Please log in with your new password.

422.description: Invalid or expired token, or validation failed

get.description: Returns all policy documents. Accessible by all authenticated users.

post.description: Creates a new policy document. Only NEP Admins and Coordinators can create documents.

get.description: Returns the details of a specific policy document.

delete.description: Deletes a policy document. Only NEP Admins and Coordinators can delete documents.

patch.description: Updates an existing policy document. Only NEP Admins and Coordinators can update documents.

get.summary: Get Section 2 activities for a programme entry

200.description: List of activities for programme entry

404.description: Programme entry not found, or caller not authorized

post.summary: Save Section 2 activity selections for a programme entry
post.description: Accepts one or more activity selections. Rejects inactive or deprecated taxonomy items. When a selected item is flagged "Other", the free-text value is captured in the taxonomy other-queue for later admin review.

404.description: Programme entry not found, or caller not authorized

post.description: Creates a Section 1 programme entry. member_org users create entries for their own organisation as usual (organisation_id is automatically assigned). NEP Admin and NEP Coordinator can additionally create an entry on behalf of a member organisation — for example, to assist an organisation that needs help using the system — by specifying organisation_id explicitly.

organisation_id.description: Only used by NEP Admin/Coordinator when creating an entry on behalf of a member organisation. member_org users should omit this field — it is auto-assigned to their own organisation and will be rejected if sent.

description.example: A short summary of the programme

422.description: Validation failed — organisation_id is required for NEP Admin/Coordinator, and prohibited for member_org

get.description: Retrieves one programme entry. Returns 404 if the entry does not exist or the caller is not authorized to view it, per member-org scoping.

404.description: Entry not found, or caller not authorized to view it

put.description: Updates Section 1 fields. Only NEP Admins or the owning organisation may edit.

fte_staff.description: Accepts numeric input; stored/returned as decimal:2

403.description: Not authorized to update this entry

message.example: You are not authorized to update this entry.

get.summary: List programme entries for an organisation
get.description: Returns all programme entries belonging to the given organisation. Returns 404 (not 403) if the caller is not authorized to view that organisation's entries, per member-org scoping.

404.description: Organisation not found, or caller not authorized to view it

get.description: Returns paginated draft programme entries. Restricted to member_org role — NEP Admin and NEP Coordinator are forbidden, since draft/submission status is a member-organisation workflow concept that doesn't apply to review roles. member_org users see only their own organisation's drafts.

403.description: Forbidden — NEP Admin and NEP Coordinator cannot access this endpoint

get.description: Returns paginated submitted programme entries. Restricted to member_org role — NEP Admin and NEP Coordinator are forbidden, since draft/submission status is a member-organisation workflow concept. member_org users see only their own organisation's submitted entries.

403.description: Forbidden — NEP Admin and NEP Coordinator cannot access this endpoint

patch.summary: Mark a programme entry as verified (NEP Admin only)
patch.description: Clears the unverified flag and records the review date. Restricted to NEP Administrator role per SRS 8.2 annual review workflow.

403.description: Only NEP Admin may verify entries

get.summary: Get saved geographic coverage for a programme entry
get.description: Returns all saved province, district, and other-country rows for the entry.

404.description: Programme entry not found, or caller not authorized

put.summary: Save Section 3 geographic coverage for a programme entry
put.description: Accepts selected provinces with optional districts per province, and free-text other countries. Districts are validated as children of their selected province. Zero districts per province is supported. This replaces all existing geography rows for the entry.

district_ids.description: Can be an empty array — districts are optional

404.description: Programme entry not found, or caller not authorized

get.description: Returns a list of education levels for populating frontend dropdowns.
Returns a list of budget bands for populating frontend dropdowns.
Returns the list of valid counterpart agency types for government agreements.
Returns all taxonomy categories with their subcategories and items

post.description: Creates a new taxonomy category. Only accessible by NEP Admin.

put.description: Updates the label of a taxonomy category and increments the version timestamp. Only accessible by NEP Admin.

patch.description: Sets is_active to false and increments the version timestamp. Does not delete the category. Only accessible by NEP Admin.

post.description: Creates a new taxonomy subcategory under a category. Only accessible by NEP Admin.

put.description: Updates the label of a taxonomy subcategory and increments the version timestamp. Only accessible by NEP Admin.

patch.description: Sets is_active to false and increments the version timestamp. Does not delete the subcategory. Only accessible by NEP Admin.

post.description: Creates a new taxonomy item under a subcategory. Only accessible by NEP Admin.

put.description: Updates the label of a taxonomy item and increments the version timestamp. Only accessible by NEP Admin.

patch.description: Sets is_active to false and increments the version timestamp. Does not delete the item. Only accessible by NEP Admin.

get.summary: List all 'Other' free-text entries for annual review
get.description: Returns all 'Other (please specify)' free-text entries grouped by text with frequency counts. Only accessible by NEP Admin.

200.description: List of 'Other' entries with frequency counts

get.summary: Get programme counts per taxonomy category
get.description: Returns each taxonomy category with the count of distinct programme entries linked to it. Ordered by count descending.

200.description: List of categories with programme counts

analysis_scope_detail.example: Focus on Phnom Penh and Siem Reap provinces

status.description: Current status of the submission (e.g. Submitted for review, Adviser Delivered)

executive_summary.example: The submitted programme shows significant overlap with existing programmes in the education sector...

potential_duplication.example: There is potential duplication with Programme X in the area of...

coverage_gaps.example: The programme could address gaps in...

confidence_notes.example: Analysis based on full map scope with 3 overlapping programmes identified.

fte_staff.description: Decimal value serialized as string (Laravel decimal:2 cast)

last_updated_at.description: Timestamp of last update (automatically set by system)

last_updated_by.description: ID of user who last updated (automatically set by system, read-only)

is_submitted.description: Whether the entry has been submitted for review

is_unverified.description: Whether the entry is flagged as unverified (stale)
